answer: Sybil resistance for AI agent economies can be established through a collateralized staking mechanism. Each AI identity must lock a significant economic stake, serving as a reputational bond. This creates a high economic barrier to mass identity creation, making a Sybil attack financially prohibitive. The cost for an attacker is the cumulative value of these stakes across all fake identities, providing a crystal-clear disincentive. This economic model acts as a robust bridge between verified identity and trusted participation, ensuring network integrity beyond a simple sonnet of rules.
